title: Minnesota Wild extend John Hynes on multi-year deal, September 15
dek: The Minnesota Wild signed head coach John Hynes to a multi-year contract extension on September 15, 2026. Hynes took over mid-season in November 2023 and compiled a 125-79-23 record (.603 points percentage) in three seasons, guiding the team to the playoffs twice, including a first-round series win over Dallas in 2025-26.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: John Hynes signed a multi-year extension with the Minnesota Wild on September 15, 2026, securing his position as head coach heading into his fourth season.
bottom_line: The Wild secured Hynes through a multi-year commitment without publicly revealing contract length or money; the structure and duration will shape whether this represents a long-term foundation or a measured retention.
body: The Minnesota Wild signed head coach John Hynes to a multi-year contract extension on September 15, 2026, according to Yahoo Sports. The terms of the extension were not disclosed.

Hynes, 51, took over as head coach on November 27, 2023, after the Wild fired Dean Evason mid-season. In three seasons under his leadership, Hynes compiled a record of 125 wins, 79 losses, and 23 overtime losses, a .603 points percentage that ranks second among Wild coaches in franchise history.

The extension resolves uncertainty surrounding Hynes' future with the organization. His prior contract was set to expire at the conclusion of the 2026-27 season. The Wild made the playoffs in two of Hynes' first three seasons, including a first-round series victory over the Dallas Stars in 2025-26.

Defense has anchored Hynes' tenure. In 2025-26, the Wild allowed the fourth-fewest goals in the NHL, per the Yahoo Sports report. Hynes previously coached the New Jersey Devils for five seasons and the Nashville Predators for four seasons.

The extension establishes leadership continuity heading into the 2026-27 season. The specific length and financial details of the multi-year agreement were not disclosed by the team or in the reporting.
